# DetectionBench Leaderboards

Curated comparison across DetectionBench's [v1 model shortlist](ROADMAP.md) only -- the same models across every dataset, for a fair comparison. Every trained model (shortlist and extras) also gets its own full HF model card with its own complete leaderboard; these tables are the smaller, cross-dataset-comparable summary. Back to the [main README](.github/README.md).
